license: CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE); databases derived from MIMIC-III and eICU (PhysioNet credentialed)
request_fields: question (+ database schema from tables.json / prompt template in the evaluating suite); target is a SQL query or abstention
notes: MIMIC-III test 1786 + eICU test 1792 = 3578 questions, of which 1176 are unanswerable (is_impossible, expected abstention). Questions and gold SQL are public; executing SQL needs the preprocessed SQLite databases (Google Drive links in README; not downloaded, they are databases not items) or credentialed PhysioNet access to rebuild them. Repo HEAD is dataset v1.5.1 (2026-04-28; question text edited since the NeurIPS 2022 release and since suites such as MedHELM pulled it). single_request=yes because each item is a natural-language data request from hospital staff answered in one turn, but the answer is SQL (text-to-SQL); could be read as structured prediction. Flag. Checked 2026-10-04; no LLMs or API keys used.

rendering.rule: Item text as released: the natural-language question only (no schema, no SQL).
